rules.title: No credential literals in source. Read secrets from the environment or a secret manager.
Pin third-party GitHub Actions to a full commit SHA; a tag or branch is a mutable pointer.
Declare least-privilege `permissions:` in every workflow; never `write-all`.
Never run a composed string through a shell. Pass argv.
Confine paths with Path.is_relative_to, not a string prefix check.
Validate archive members before extraction; extractall writes anywhere its names point.
Catch the exceptions you can handle; never swallow everything silently.
Every network call needs an explicit timeout, or it hangs forever by default.
Bound subprocess calls with a timeout so a wedged child cannot hang the run.
Validate environment variables at startup rather than failing with a KeyError deep in a call.
Do not log values held in secret-named variables.
Pin dependency versions exactly so a build is a function of its lockfile.
A mutable default argument is shared across every call.
Use an explicit guard and a raised error, not assert — assertions vanish under -O.
Containers must declare a non-root USER.
Pin base images to a digest or an exact version, never `latest`.
